text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT 1748214321 - automated alert: unusual session-mirroring activity detected. matched pattern: S3 upload by log-forwarder to staging-archive with session-like payloads. paging oncall.

maria oncall: ack — I'm oncall, taking lead. tagging sec and sre. :hand: /assign

jordan (sre): on it. can someone paste the sample object key and the window?

lin (backend): initial find — 14 objects: s3://staging-archive/session-dumps/2024-06-23-03{12..18}.json.gz. uploads from log-forwarder instance ids i-0abc..; requests show POST /internal/session/restore with X-Forwarded-For set. sending a short sample (redacted) in DM. :eyes:

sam (security): copying. any tokens present? need to determine scope (prod vs staging), and if PII present.

lin (backend): quick grep: snippets include session_id, user_email (SHA1 hashed), and "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-frag>" fragments in 3 objects. not full-length tokens, but fragments exist.

maria oncall: customer impact? any live traffic or only staging/dev tenants?

kevin (product): no customer reports so far. looks like staging pipelines only, but we should assume worst until confirmed. product requests we avoid mass revokes if only staging.

jordan (sre): mitigation plan — short list:
1) Pause log-forwarder job (prevent further uploads).
2) Lock down S3 bucket (remove public grants, enable logging).
3) Quarantine suspect objects and collect audit hashes.
4) Rotate any involved service credentials and short-lived secrets.
5) Assess PII; notify legal/compliance if confirmed.

lin (backend): executing step 1 now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deploy log-forwarder --replicas=0
```
opsbot: deployment scaled: log-forwarder -> 0 replicas (controller: infra/log-forwarder)

lin (backend): starting inventory & quarantine job to copy suspect objects to secure bucket and then remove originals.

jordan (sre): locking bucket ACLs and policy now. removing public ACLs and any cross-account grants. enabling S3 access logging to secure-audit-bucket.

sam (security): starting credential rotation for SVC_LOGGER_KEY and SVC_ARCHIVER_ROLE. I'll create rotation request and block any long-lived tokens in staging.

maria oncall: assigning tasks — @lin: pause forwarder + inventory/quarantine; @jordan: bucket lockdown, enable logging, gather access logs; @sam: rotate keys + coordinate legal if PII; I'll manage pagerduty and customer comms if needed.

lin (backend): inventory results: 14 suspect objects uploaded 2024-06-23T03:12:05Z -> 2024-06-23T03:18:47Z. copying list to secure channel and kicking off delete after hashing.

jordan (sre): bucket policy updated, public grants removed, access logging enabled. collecting S3 server access logs and CloudTrail events for the window.

sam (security): rotation in-progress: requesting new SVC_LOGGER_KEY via secrets-manager, updating staging deploy manifest to consume rotated secret (staged rollout). will revoke old key after test.

maria oncall: are we seeing any traffic from those session IDs to production endpoints?

lin (backend): scanned proxy logs; no matching session_ids in production access logs. looks confined to staging.

kevin (product): product asks to limit impact to staging only; please confirm before any customer token invalidations.

sam (security): agreed — we will avoid customer-facing token invalidations for now. we will, however, invalidate staging environment session tokens and any long-lived service tokens that could be abused.

maria oncall: legal/compliance — please standby. treat hashed emails as potentially sensitive until proven otherwise.

opsbot: quarantine job status: copying 14 objects -> secure-quarantine-bucket. 12/14 copied and removed; 2 failed due to ACLs.

jordan (sre): fixed permissions on remaining two objects, scrubbed them. generating SHA256 hashes of deleted objects and storing in audit bucket.

lin (backend): scrub command used:
```bash
aws s3 rm s3://staging-archive/session-dumps/2024-06-23-03{12..18}.json.gz --profile staging-ops && aws s3 cp s3://staging-archive/session-dumps/2024-06-23-03{12..18}.json.gz s3://secure-quarantine/ --profile staging-ops
```

sam (security): rotation complete for SVC_LOGGER_KEY at 04:05 UTC and SVC_ARCHIVER_ROLE temporary creds rotated. old keys revoked. updated Secrets Manager entries and triggered config refresh for staging.

maria oncall: timeline summary for notes: forwarder paused 03:25 UTC; bucket lockdown 03:30 UTC; first scrub attempts 03:40 UTC; credential rotation 04:05 UTC; final scrub/audit 04:40 UTC.

kevin (product): confirm no customer impact reported; product will monitor support queue and escalate if anything appears.

sam (security): treating user_email hashes as sensitive; legal loop-in requested. compliance will triage PII risk and confirm notification requirements.

jordan (sre): collecting all artifacts for postmortem: CloudTrail, S3 access logs, forwarder logs, instance IDs, and the hashes of deleted objects.

maria oncall: thanks team. scheduling postmortem review 09:00 UTC today; invite: sec, sre, backend, product, legal, devex.

maria oncall: closing this thread for live mitigation — continuing offline w/ legal/compliance. follow-up thread will contain postmortem and action items. :white_check_mark:
